title: PTNK Candidate Knowledge Atom
description: Schema for reviewable candidate knowledge atoms. This is distinct from the official promoted knowledge-atom schema; candidate fields preserve source analysis, evidence, context, and human-review metadata.

atom_type.description: Proposed type of knowledge represented by the candidate.

part_of_speech.description: Source-stated or context-supported part of speech; preserve the field even when unavailable.

sense.description: Proposed sense/meaning description when the candidate is represented using the sense field. Preserve the field even when the source instead supplies a definition.

definition.description: Source-provided definition, preserved verbatim when available. This field is retained for candidates that use definition rather than sense.

mother_says.description: Learner-facing Vietnamese meaning of the proposed verified sense. If explanatory wording is needed beyond the concise equivalent, put that explanation in parentheses immediately after the equivalent(s). Leave blank when not yet established; never guess.

source_status.description: Status of the candidate's substantive claim relative to the source, such as source-stated or inferred.

source_example.description: Source example supporting the proposed sense. Leave blank when unavailable; do not invent source evidence.
